semantic_roundtrip.remaining_semantic_delta: The constant-one finite bound with eta=1/sqrt(T) is an explicit instantiation of the source fixed-step OSD transfer,not a formula printed in Example2.32. The total finite-history policy interface is a library model of played-legal support choices. The eventual conclusion is one-sided across separately prescribed horizons. Norm/clamp helpers admit broader inputs than the source performance game. The source full ambient subdifferential is reused on the fixed unit interval. A fixed deterministic policy receives whole loss functions and finite actual histories; performance requires global supporting vectors only at played points. The constant-one square-root bound is derived for a positive prescribed horizon with feasible initialization,labels and comparator. The eventual signed upper-average result concerns a separately tuned horizon family, not ordinary signed convergence or a single anytime run. Clamp and prefix identities are total and do not imply performance for invalid inputs. No randomized strategy law,executable finite-query oracle,externally certified parameter independence,attained best-hindsight minimum,chapter/book completion,purification or Exposition Seal is asserted.
